name: TV Turn Off
description: The first clip collapses into a glowing line and a dot, like an old TV turned off, then the second powers on from the dot. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the switched-off screen (the original is black; a dark gray reads as a screen)

params.name: glow
params.description: Strength of the glow around the line and the dot
